about: King George Co., VA, Will Book 2: AI second-pass review of all 77 wills against the original abstract text, replacing the earlier lighter review (missing enslaved names and bequest rows). Each record fully replaces the automatic extraction for the will matched by key [vol, pages, auto_testator] in src/auto_wills.txt. Same conventions as kg-3.json.
